items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Stanton sold the plantation out... I was born there. Born there.

ctx.x: Was that down the coast too? Yeah, yeah. That's at the Cut-Off. At the Cut-Off, yeah. Where did Jimmy Noon come from?
That's where he come from. Stanton. Stanton. But now after Stanton sold the plantation out, Jimmy Noon moved across the river. His family moved across the river.
So where was Stanton? On this side?
